title: Idk what should be next steps for my game
author: TheNutdev
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/5hv9rk9x5jrh1.png?width=2616&format=png&auto=webp&s=97c3ecf33a326602717676cc305a29f6ad121878

I built a drifting game with simple low poly models and 2 tracks to test out mechanics. Drifting honestly feels really good, I focused a lot on that to make it actually fun. Game also has controller suport. I added new track, some visual and sound effects to make game feel even better and give player better update. Right now I have working game that gives fun for 5-10mins of gameplay but idk where to go next lol. Any recommendations? I want to keep the arcade feel of the game so I was thinking about heading into this direction, add some more tracks, cars and challenges so players can actually feel progress. I deployed and it can be play tested in browser, I can send you link (i don't want to selfpromo bs).  
Thanks in advance.

comments.author: cckynv
comments.body: I think some challenges like score targets, sustained drift duration, etc. would be a good addition. Just drifting around the track will only take you so far in terms of gameplay.

replies.author: TheNutdev
replies.body: Thanks, I think I still miss a confirmation if game feels good but closing a full loop (like building a challange/race) might encourage more people to complete it and give feedback.

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body:
I would say study other games similar to yours and see how they compare to yours and see what those are missing and build out from their   
Car customization   
Coloring parts etc  
Upgrades  
Buying new cars   
Etc
